confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on aggregator and blog price ranges for Bali-wide cafés and warungs. Canggu-specific figures were thin, and no current menus were verified. Cocktail is a pre-tax estimate from a Sanur listing and a 2025 Denpasar aggregator. Wine is set from the beer relationship because no current wine price list was found. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge and July high-season context; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX observation is the latest RBA figure I could retrieve (20 March 2026). It is not confirmed as the latest RBA observation on 2026-10-16, and third-party October 2026 readings were near 0.69, so it may be stale. The USD anchors assume an approximate IDR/USD rate of about 16,500.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bali-wide aggregated price data, with Ubud and Canggu treated as higher than the island average. Pricing is positioned qualitatively against other Southeast Asian resort-town tourist markets; no specific comparable city was searched or priced.
